title: Overview
description: What came in, what shipped, and what is waiting on your call.

created.title: New work items
created.caption: Daily new work items over the last {{days}} days.
created.trendAria: Daily trend of new work items over the last {{days}} days

delivered.title: Completed work items
delivered.method: Method: work items entering a DONE-category status within the selected range are counted once per work item; canceled items are excluded. The change compares the previous period of equal length. Counted by completion time.

pending.title: My pending work items
pending.caption: All pending
pending.hint: Not limited by the stats range above; every unfinished work item assigned to you is listed.
pending.name: Title
pending.loadFailure: Failed to load pending work items
pending.emptyHint: Adjust the range, or clear the items currently waiting on you

createdList.title: New work items ({{range}})
createdList.caption: Selected range
createdList.hint: Same scope as the New work items card above: every work item created in the selected range, including canceled ones; the list length equals the card value.
createdList.name: Title
createdList.empty: No new work items in the selected range
createdList.loadFailure: Failed to load new work items
createdList.emptyHint: No work items were created in this range

leadTime.title: Avg. Delivery Lead Time
leadTime.method: Average time from creation to the DONE entry event for workitems completed in the range; the previous period is the adjacent window of equal length, and a previous period with no completions has no comparable base.
leadTime.noBase: No completions in this or previous period
leadTime.caption: Average time from creation to completion

inProgress.title: In-Progress Workitems
inProgress.caption: Snapshot at query time (unfinished categories incl. pending decision); not compared over time

firstPass.title: First-Pass Rate
firstPass.method: Share of SUCCEEDED dispatches with attempt=0 in the range; scoped to formal delivery dispatches, consistent with Insights.
firstPass.noData: No successful dispatches in the range
firstPass.caption: Dispatches that succeeded without retries

rework.title: Rework Rate
rework.method: Share of dispatches reworked by review comments or retried after failure (three-part idempotency key with attempt>=2); consistent with the realtime board.
rework.caption: Dispatches reworked by review or retry

tokens.title: Token Usage
tokens.trendAria: Daily token usage trend in the range

failures.title: Top Failure Reasons
failures.caption: By count
failures.empty: No failed or timed-out dispatches in the range
failures.emptyHint: Every dispatch in this range finished successfully
